out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. CDI: PROCEDURES PROVIDED OVER EMAIL.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW SALMON ABOVE COOKED SHRIMP IN THE WALK-IN COOLER
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: RAW SALMON MOVED TO THE SHELF BELOW. STAFF RE-EDUCATED.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED SPICY BULGOGI AT 121F (1HR) AND REGULAR BULGOGI AT 117F (1HR) IN THE STEAM TABLE IN THE FOOD PREP AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: BULGOGIS TAKEN TO BACK TO REHEAT TO 165F.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED HALF AND HALF AT 46F IN THE ONE-DOOR STANDING COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: HALF AND HALF DISPOSED OF.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Observed in the walk-in cooler, vacuum package cooked shrimp, cooked crab, raw tuna, cooked octopus and raw white tuna being thawed inside vacuum packaging without being removed from the reduced oxygen environment
violations.corrective_action: Person in charge had employee open vacuum packaging before they continue thawing out the raw and cooked fish

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: rice being stored in opaque trash cans ( used for storage) did not have common name labels
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC made labels for the rice storage bins

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the @Physical structure@ is not maintained in good repair. observed flashing tape being used to secure two compartment sink to the wall kitchen
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PIC agreed to have the two compartment sink repaired.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: EHS observed beef bulgogi and salmon being stored on the floor of the walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS spoke to PIC about issue of food storage on floor of walk in cooler, PIC moved food so it’s as being stored on shelf at least 6 inches above the floor.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Utility Lines/Pipes, Not Exposed
violations.observation: EHS observed the compressor unit above the walk in cooler exposed via a missing ceiling tile.
violations.corrective_action: Utility line and pipes cannot be unnecessarily exposed on a wall or ceiling. EHS asked PIC to replace ceiling tile by next inspection

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: OBSERVED RAW TUNA PACKAGES THAWING IN WIC WITH PACKAGING INTACT.
violations.corrective_action: EHS EDUCATED CFM ON PROPER THAWING OF ROP FISH. CFM WILL CUT PACKAGING OF ROP FISH BEFORE THAWING IN REFRIGERATOR.
